title: Jerk Chicken with Rice and Peas
method: Cut each chicken breast on a plastic board and halve each one, leaving joined at top.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with salt and pepper, then rub both sides.
Put into hot pan, skin side down to cook.
Chop 4 spring onions, blend with thyme, bay leaves, pinch of each spice, rum, vinegar, honey, chilli, and garlic. Add olive oil to loosen if needed.
Turn chicken over, pour over jerk sauce, drizzle 1 tbsp honey and thyme. Cook for 15 mins.
Finely slice 2 spring onions, place in saucepan with cinnamon stick, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Soften for 1 min.
Add rice, chicken stock, rinsed black beans. Bring to boil, cover, reduce heat and simmer 12 mins.
